# Md. Farhan Sadik

> Software Engineer from Bangladesh specializing in full-stack web development, modern web applications, AI-powered applications and cloud technologies.

Farhan builds healthcare web applications at Neeramoy Digital Services, working across the stack with Angular, React, Next.js, Python, Firebase and AWS. He graduated in Computer Science & Engineering from BRAC University in 2025.
